t: Of the funds appropriated under this head in the Department of Housing and Urban Development—Independent Agencies Appropriation Act, 1980, $6,500,000 are rescinded.

fable.w: This section only rescinds $6,500,000 of previously appropriated funds. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government, and there is no tempting participation-like language at all.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple rescission of appropriated funds. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process involving parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: Of the funds appropriated under this head in the Department of Housing and Urban Development—Independent Agencies Appropriation Act, 1980, $6,500,000 are rescinded.

opus.w: This provision only rescinds $6,500,000 of previously appropriated funds. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, or right to sue for anyone outside the federal government. Nothing in the text suggests outside parties take part in a federal decision.
opus.s: Of the funds appropriated under this head in the Department of Housing and Urban Development—Independent Agencies Appropriation Act, 1980, $6,500,000 are rescinded.

qwen_chat.w: This section simply rescinds a specific amount of appropriated funds. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or participation with parties outside the federal government (such as states, tribes, the public, or private entities) before making a decision. The action is a unilateral budgetary adjustment by Congress.
qwen_chat.s: Of the funds appropriated under this head in the Department of Housing and Urban Development—Independent Agencies Appropriation Act, 1980, $6,500,000 are rescinded.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that rescinding funds is a decision that affects the public, but the text itself contains no mechanism for public input, consultation, or participation in that decision. It is a unilateral legislative action regarding budget execution.
